WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    college_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as count
  FROM player_college
  GROUP BY college_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(count) as avg_all,
    SUM(count) as sum_all
  FROM college_counts
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT cc.count, s.avg_all, s.sum_all
  FROM college_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE cc.count > s.avg_all
)
SELECT 
  AVG(count) as metric_1,
  AVG(CAST(count AS NUMERIC) / sum_all) as metric_2,
  AVG(count - avg_all) as metric_3
FROM above_avg
